summary: Session-2 LIVE browser journey audit (J1-J4) with a FRESH disposable signup. Successfully exercised: fresh signup, 'Hi' + longer chat turns, connect-repo banner CTA -> NewUserWizard, /login bad-password error path, logout + relogin (Day-2 simulation), SessionSwitcher (topbar) 2-session creation + delete-chat themed confirm modal (Cancel path AND Approve path). BLOCKED: full drill-repo connect + ship (J1 continued, J3, K1 fallback live) because a fresh signup requires an external GitHub App installation flow (installation 152797252 is authorized on the preview backend for existing test users, but a brand-new user identity has no repos exposed to the wizard -- only 'Continue with GitHub App' install-btn is offered, no manual-typed-repo fallback in the wizard for the drill account). Persona 'Maya' verdict: friction is manageable but two chat-list surfaces + short first reply + banner counter copy are quit-risks.

ui_bugs.issue: After approving deletion of the CURRENTLY-VIEWING session, the switcher panel closes and remaining row count drops to 0 in the DOM (expected 1). May be a stale-render / panel-remount artifact rather than an actual data loss -- rows likely reappear on next panel open, but was not re-verified in this run. Cosmetic/UX only, not data loss.

Duplicate chat-delete surface exists in the *legacy left-sidebar* Recent Chats. Its trash button [data-testid=delete-session-{id}] calls deleteSession(e, s.session_id) DIRECTLY with no confirm modal and no window.confirm. Currently NOT rendered in the v2 dashboard shell used by fresh users (delete-session-* elements = 0 in DOM), so the P0-2 fix effectively covers the visible path, but if any route/user still lands on the old expanded Shell layout, they will get a zero-confirm silent delete. Recommend either (a) removing this duplicate surface entirely, or (b) refactoring it to also call the new DeleteChatConfirmModal via a shared hook.

[data-testid=connect-repo-banner] intercepts pointer events on [data-testid=session-switcher-btn] under normal Playwright click (had to use JS .click() to bypass). Regular users won't see this (banner is above topbar, not on top of it), but it's a stacking-context leak worth noting.

integration_issues.issue: New-user wizard offers ONLY 'Continue with GitHub App' (install-btn) for a fresh identity — no way to reuse an already-authorized install (installation 152797252 on the preview backend) from a new email. A dev-founder Maya on Day 1 will have to complete an external OAuth pop-up before they can see ANY of the ship flow. Consider: (a) surface an existing install to freshly-signed-up users on the same preview pod, (b) offer 'Try with sample repo' shortcut for demo/onboarding purposes.

design_issues.screen: Banner 'Connect a repo to unlock your free SEO fix'
issues: Counter reads '500 of 500 founder spots remaining' on a brand-new signup regardless of actual traction — feels like copy-marketing rather than live data. If it IS live and always shows 500/500, users may distrust the numbers elsewhere in the app.

Copy uses 'Aurem GitHub App' inside the banner body but the assistant intro says 'ORA by Aurem' — internally consistent (Aurem = company, ORA = product), but a first-time reader may not parse that instantly.

Top-left project label reads 'AUREM DEV' on the /login page but 'No repo connected' on /dashboard — no ORA/product name in the topbar; brand chip is orange dot only. Consistent 'ORA' presence in the topbar (not just body copy) would reinforce identity.

j1_top3_friction_moments: After signup, banner CTA opens a wizard that gives no way to move forward without an external GitHub OAuth popup — a first-time Maya has literally zero explored UI to click if she isn't ready to install a GitHub App right now.

First 'Hi' reply is a 4-word generic greeting ('Hey there! How can I help you today?') — feels canned; only when she asks a concrete question does substance appear. A dev-founder may pattern-match this to 'demo/mock chatbot, not a real coder' and bail.

Two visible chat surfaces (topbar 'Chats (n)' popover AND the sidebar 'recent chats' rail when expanded) with subtly different trash-icon behaviors, plus a 'ORA GUIDE' tooltip pointing at a different button than the banner CTA — cognitive overload in the first 60 seconds.
j2_top3_friction_moments: Deleting the session she's currently viewing empties the switcher panel visually (2->0 rows) instead of dropping to 1 and switching her to the survivor — Maya loses her place with no clear 'now viewing X' cue.
No visible ✓ 'Chat deleted' toast/undo after Approve — the panel just closes; if she mis-clicked she has no rescue path.
Re-login preserves session cookies but there's no 'Welcome back, Maya' or 'you were last shipping X' state cue — day-2 feels indistinguishable from day-1 (missed retention lever).
j3_top3_friction_moments: NOT REACHED — cannot connect the drill repo as a fresh signup on this preview pod; see integration_issues above.
j4_top3_friction_moments: The bad-login error UI is excellent (themed, plain English, ORA voice, actionable). No friction here. Real friction we could NOT hit: rate-limit, network-drop mid-chat, and ship-fail paths — all gated behind 'have a repo connected' which the fresh signup cannot complete without external OAuth.
